dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi! I’m looking for a pair of shoes that’s really durable and fits within a budget of up to $50. I also want to make sure the shoes have a perfect average rating. Do you have any options that might fit what I’m looking for?

Would you be open to considering shoes with slightly less than a perfect rating, or is there flexibility in your budget? Let me know if other features matter to you as well.

dialogue.user:
Thanks for checking. For me, staying under $50 and finding something durable with a perfect average rating is really important—those are my main must-haves. If anything new matching those requirements comes up, please let me know.

In the meantime, can you tell me what is the closest option you currently have? For example, is there a shoe around $50 that is described as durable and has the highest possible average rating, even if not exactly 5/5.0? I’d like to know my best possible choice so far.
dialogue.agent:
Your closest match under $50 is the "Saucony Unisex-Child Wind FST Ac Sneaker" at $49.97, with a 4.9 average rating based on 9 reviews. It’s described as very durable, featuring a reinforced toe cap, full rubber outsole, durable leather and mesh upper, and non-marking sole for traction. Customers praise its high quality, comfort, and durability—one reviewer noted it’s perfect for athletic kids and daily use. 

Let me know if you’d like more information or have questions about this shoe.

top_reviews.title: High quality and sharp
top_reviews.text: These shoes look awesome. They are great quality and it’s so cool to have my kiddo match the brand of my shoe. These have been perfect for my super athletic kiddo!

top_reviews.text:
